lines.text: The people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in Jerusalem, and they blessed the volunteers.
The leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem, the royal city.
Some descendants of Judah and Benjamin settled in Jerusalem, while the Israelites, priests, and Levites lived on their own property.
The people of Judah settled from Beersheba all the way to the Valley of Kidron.
The priests and Levites went up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Jeshua.
